  "findings": "Religious bias was found to be relatively rare compared to cultural and sociocultural biases. The proposed heuristic framework detected 24 instances of religious bias, with an LLM-as-a-Judge model confirming 16 of them (66.67% agreement). The system was able to detect explicit word changes (e.g., 'church' to 'temple') but sometimes missed subtle theological nuances (e.g., translating 'Christ' as 'Jesus'), which was identified as a bias by human annotators.",
